description: Manifest of assets included or required for the phase-ready game build.

files.description: Main lobby scene with re-enabled modular skybox, floor, skyline, signage, real table and dealer/player bot positions.
Real poker table model with stable felt, pass-line, wood rail and hidden blink meshes.
Rigged male skeletal mesh used as the base for dealer and seated player bots.
Seated pose used for player bots to appear anchored to their chairs.
Mesh reference for Eric; can be bound to the rigged skeleton for the final dealer.
Forearm HUD implementation that draws the poker HUD on a hidden canvas and projects it onto the watch.
Quest-specific wrist-watch implementation that anchors the HUD to XR hands and listens for hand joints.
Default lobby soundtrack introduced in v2.4.2; to be replaced or supplemented with '07.mp3' when provided.
